trust_boundary.claim_acceptance: A source claim is usable for a decisive screen only when its exact locator and evidence artifact are recorded with a decisive read status.
trust_boundary.unknown_policy: Missing or unresolved evidence remains unknown and creates a property-resolution task; it is never coerced to false or treated as novelty.
trust_boundary.screen_scope: Applicability and bounded-negative decisions apply only to the named mechanism instance and never close an entire route by implication.
trust_boundary.authorization_boundary: Typed cells, generated seeds, and desk decisions authorize no experiment, target computation, route promotion, or security claim.

source_claims.citation: Amadori, Pintore, and Sala, On the Discrete Logarithm Problem for Prime-Field Elliptic Curves.
source_claims.statement: The source is adjacent prior art for prime-field index-calculus variants and must be read before any novelty claim in that mechanism family.
source_claims.boundary: Metadata does not support a decisive mathematical claim and is retained only as an unresolved prior-art obligation.

source_claims.citation: Faugere, Huot, Joux, Renault, and Vitse, EUROCRYPT 2014, Symmetrized Summation Polynomials.
source_claims.statement: A rational small-order torsion point can act coordinatewise on summation-polynomial variables; the relation-preserving subgroup can grow with the number of free variables.
source_claims.boundary: This is a mechanism and conditional complexity result for curves with the required rational torsion, not evidence that secp256k1 has that target property.

source_claims.citation: Lean GLV endomorphism and order-three automorphism package.
source_claims.statement: The secp256k1 map sending x to beta times x and preserving y is a nontrivial additive automorphism of order three.
source_claims.boundary: Existence of the automorphism alone gives no asymptotic discrete-log improvement and does not imply independent coordinatewise covariance.

source_claims.citation: Exact symbolic fixed-target GLV-Semaev classification certificate.
source_claims.statement: For nonzero affine target coordinate and the stated characteristic assumptions, only the identity coordinate scaling preserves the fixed-target S4 layer.
source_claims.boundary: The result concerns coordinatewise scalar C3 actions; it is not a Groebner lower bound and does not close faithful phase-preserving constructions.

source_claims.citation: Exact symbolic GLV-Semaev coordinate-scaling classification certificate.
source_claims.statement: The replayed exact certificate finds only the diagonal C3 coordinate-scaling covariance for S3 and S4 among the enumerated coordinatewise C3 action.
source_claims.boundary: This certificate-backed exhaustiveness result is not a Lean theorem and excludes neither non-scalar nor birational mechanisms.

source_claims.citation: Lean GLV-Semaev diagonal covariance and fixed-target transport package.
source_claims.statement: Lean proves diagonal S3 covariance, diagonal S4 invariance, and the exact transport of S4 fibers and point relations under the GLV map.
source_claims.boundary: The kernel package proves positive identities and transport laws; it does not prove exhaustive coordinatewise stabilizer classification.

source_claims.citation: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, PKC 2016, auxiliary-curve construction.
source_claims.statement: For an arbitrary prime p, a second construction searches for an auxiliary curve over the same field whose order has a sufficiently large smooth factor, then uses a self-isogeny of that auxiliary curve to define the composed root map.
source_claims.boundary: The auxiliary curve is a priori unrelated to the ECDLP target curve beyond sharing the field. Search, map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total attack cost remain separate obligations.

source_claims.citation: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, PKC 2016, Algebraic Approaches for the ECDLP over Prime Fields.
source_claims.statement: One faithful prime-field factor-base construction uses roots produced from a sufficiently large smooth-order subgroup of the multiplicative group of the base field.
source_claims.boundary: The construction supplies an applicability condition and generalized-root problem; it does not by itself establish an end-to-end advantage on secp256k1.

source_claims.statement: Every rational secp256k1 point over the base field annihilated by multiplication by two is the identity point.
source_claims.boundary: This excludes direct rational two-torsion on secp256k1 over the base field only; it does not exclude auxiliary curves or extension fields.

source_claims.citation: Lean Pratt certificate and exact p-minus-one factorization used in secp256k1_p_prime.
source_claims.statement: For the secp256k1 field prime, p-1 equals 2 times 3 times 7 times 13441 times the proved-prime 237-bit cofactor.
source_claims.boundary: The factorization determines available multiplicative subgroup orders; it does not decide the total relation-generation or Groebner cost.

source_claims.statement: secp256k1 is defined over a 256-bit prime field and exposes its specified affine curve representation.
source_claims.boundary: Coordinate access is an opportunity surface, not evidence that a non-generic relation algorithm beats the generic square-root baseline.

source_claims.citation: Lean Semaev S3 and S4 relation-semantics package.
source_claims.statement: The formalized Semaev polynomials provide checked algebraic implications between point-sum relations and polynomial vanishing in the covered cases.
source_claims.boundary: The current Lean package is not an end-to-end prime-field index-calculus algorithm and does not supply relation probabilities or solver complexity.

target_properties.label: Direct rational two-torsion
target_properties.statement: The secp256k1 base-field point group contains no nonidentity point of order dividing two.
target_properties.scope: Direct secp256k1 over the specified prime base field only.

target_properties.label: Nontrivial GLV order-three action
target_properties.statement: secp256k1 carries the nontrivial order-three GLV automorphism used by the structural route.
target_properties.scope: The secp256k1 point group and its affine coordinate representation.

target_properties.label: PKC auxiliary-curve instance
target_properties.statement: No explicit auxiliary curve over the secp256k1 base field with the required smooth order factor and fully priced composed map is recorded yet.
target_properties.scope: The shared base field and the exact PKC 2016 auxiliary-curve construction; no isogeny to secp256k1 is required.

target_properties.label: Available smooth divisor below the large prime cofactor
target_properties.statement: The product of the small prime factors 2, 3, 7, and 13441 in p-1 is 564522.
target_properties.scope: Multiplicative group of the secp256k1 base field.

target_properties.label: Prime-field coordinate representation
target_properties.statement: The target is a curve over the specified 256-bit prime field with accessible coordinate formulas.
target_properties.scope: Public secp256k1 domain parameters and classical non-generic analysis.

cost_quantities.label: Faithful GLV phase-quotient solving cost
cost_quantities.definition: End-to-end relation-generation cost after retaining all relative GLV phase information, including quotient construction, recovery, excluded components, and solver work.
cost_quantities.baseline: Matched Semaev relation collection without the proposed quotient, with identical target, factor base, relation arity, and success criterion.
cost_quantities.measurement: Require an exact map and recovery algorithm, then compare preregistered scaling laws rather than one solver timing.

cost_quantities.label: Generalized root-finding and recovery cost
cost_quantities.definition: Cost of solving the composed-map fiber constraints and recovering valid factor-base points without hidden discarded components.
cost_quantities.baseline: Direct factor-base membership and relation recovery at the same arity and effective factor-base size.
cost_quantities.measurement: Price all roots, spurious fibers, recovery failures, preprocessing, and independent relation validation as field size grows.

cost_quantities.label: Total prime-field relation-generation cost
cost_quantities.definition: Online and offline cost of obtaining enough independently validated full relations, including factor-base construction, polynomial solving, recovery, and linear algebra.
cost_quantities.baseline: The generic square-root attack and the matched plain Semaev pipeline must both be priced under the same threat model.
cost_quantities.measurement: Record scaling across field sizes with matched baselines and retain every preprocessing, memory, parallelism, and amortization term.

cost_quantities.label: Relation-preserving coordinatewise subgroup growth
cost_quantities.definition: The order of the coordinatewise curve-symmetry subgroup preserving the fixed-target relation, expressed as a function of relation arity.
cost_quantities.baseline: A subgroup whose order is bounded independently of arity supplies only bounded orbit compression unless another cost lever is proved.
cost_quantities.measurement: Derive the action on the point-sum relation, classify its preserving subgroup, and verify the formula independently.

cost_quantities.label: Semaev S15 system construction and solving cost
cost_quantities.definition: Total cost of constructing, representing, solving, and validating the relation system required by an arity-fourteen smooth-subgroup instantiation.
cost_quantities.baseline: The same success probability priced against generic square-root work and lower-arity prime-field relation pipelines.
cost_quantities.measurement: An exact symbolic size bound must precede any solver run; degree, monomial count, memory, and recovery are all included.

barriers.exact_scope: Processing a target together with its two GLV images is a finite target-batching factor and is not by itself an asymptotic relation-generation bridge.
reopening_conditions: Prove a distinct mechanism changing a cost quantity with field size or relation arity rather than relying only on the three target images.

barriers.exact_scope: Replacing every free coordinate independently by its cube is not a faithful quotient of the fixed-target GLV-Semaev relation system.
reopening_conditions: Provide a different exact quotient with relative phase tags, an inverse recovery map, and a cost bridge not based on the closed independent-cube identification.

barriers.exact_scope: The m-equals-four smooth-subgroup instance cannot obtain a factor base near size two-to-the-sixty-four from the small-factor part of secp256k1 p-minus-one.
reopening_conditions: Change the exact construction or arity and reprice the complete system; do not reinterpret this instance-level shortfall as route-wide inapplicability.

cells.scope: Apply the published coordinatewise rational two-torsion translation mechanism directly to secp256k1 over its base field.
cells.construction: Translate selected free points by one rational point of order two so the even-weight coordinate action preserves their sum.
cells.relation_action: For an order-two point T, translating an even number of free variables adds an even multiple of T and preserves the fixed target.
cells.changed_quantity: The relation-preserving subgroup would have order growing exponentially with relation arity.

cost_quantity.label: Relation-preserving coordinatewise subgroup growth
cost_quantity.definition: The order of the coordinatewise curve-symmetry subgroup preserving the fixed-target relation, expressed as a function of relation arity.
cost_quantity.baseline: A subgroup whose order is bounded independently of arity supplies only bounded orbit compression unless another cost lever is proved.
cost_quantity.measurement: Derive the action on the point-sum relation, classify its preserving subgroup, and verify the formula independently.

requirement_results.rationale: The direct published action requires a nonidentity rational point of order two on the target curve.

cells.boundary: The failed target property excludes only direct base-field use; auxiliary curves, extension fields, and unrelated sum-compatible actions remain separate.

cells.scope: A not-yet-specified quotient that retains enough relative GLV phase data to preserve and recover fixed-target Semaev relations.
cells.construction: Use mixed diagonal invariants or explicit phase tags with a total recovery map instead of independent coordinate cubes.
cells.relation_action: The construction must preserve the exact fixed-target relation and distinguish all phase combinations merged by the naive quotient.
cells.changed_quantity: Unknown effect on solving degree, sparse support, mixed volume, recovery cost, or full relation cost.

cells.scope: Fixed-target Semaev relation systems with every free x-coordinate replaced independently by its cube.
cells.construction: Map each x_i to u_i equals x_i cubed and discard all relative GLV phase information.
cells.relation_action: The map quotients a coordinatewise C3 power, while the exact relation admits only the diagonal C3 action.
cells.changed_quantity: Proposed variable-domain compression by independent phase removal.

cost_quantity.baseline: A subgroup whose order is bounded independently of arity supplies only bounded orbit compression unless another cost lever is proved.
cost_quantity.measurement: Derive the action on the point-sum relation, classify its preserving subgroup, and verify the formula independently.

requirement_results.rationale: The proposed coordinate cubes are motivated by the actual order-three GLV action.

cells.boundary: This bounded negative does not close faithful phase-preserving, non-scalar, or birational GLV-Semaev mechanisms.

cells.scope: Construct or rule out a fully priced auxiliary-curve instance over the secp256k1 base field under the exact PKC 2016 conditions.
cells.construction: Find an auxiliary curve E0 over the same field whose order contains a B-smooth factor near p to the one-over-m scale; use the kernel self-isogeny on E0 to construct the composed root map L for target-curve factor-base coordinates.
cells.relation_action: The original target curve remains the relation group. The auxiliary self-isogeny defines only the root set and low-degree decomposition of L; all recovered x-values must still lift to valid target-curve points and relations.
cells.changed_quantity: Auxiliary-curve search, composed-map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total relation-generation cost.

cells.scope: Desk-cost analysis of the PKC 2016 smooth-subgroup construction at an arity where the available divisor is large enough in principle.
cells.construction: Use the available smooth divisor 564522 of p-minus-one, which exceeds the exact arity-fourteen threshold 319558, and price the resulting relation system and recovery path.
cells.relation_action: The construction can satisfy the raw factor-base-size predicate only by moving to a much higher-arity Semaev relation.
cells.changed_quantity: Total construction, representation, solving, and recovery cost of the corresponding S15 system.

cost_quantity.baseline: The same success probability priced against generic square-root work and lower-arity prime-field relation pipelines.

requirement_results.rationale: The available small-factor product exceeds the exact ceiling of p to the one-fourteenth, so raw factor-base scale alone does not reject this arity.

cells.boundary: This open desk-cost cell does not justify an S15 solver run; an exact symbolic size and cost bound is required first.

cells.scope: Instantiate the PKC 2016 multiplicative smooth-subgroup factor-base construction at relation arity four for secp256k1.
cells.construction: Build a faithful composed-map factor base from a smooth divisor of p-minus-one large enough for the arity-four relation target.
cells.relation_action: The factor-base polynomial is compiled into the Semaev relation system and recovered through the published composed map.
cells.changed_quantity: Proposed factor-base construction and generalized-root cost at arity four.

desk_decisions.rationale: Exact symbolic replay shows that independent coordinate cubes erase relative phases not identified by the diagonal GLV action, so this quotient is not faithful to the fixed-target relation.
reopening_conditions: A different exact phase-preserving quotient with complete recovery and a cost-changing bridge may be submitted as a new mechanism.

desk_decisions.rationale: The published direct torsion-translation mechanism requires a nonidentity rational two-torsion point, while the Lean kernel proves that secp256k1 has no such base-field point.
reopening_conditions: A distinct sum-compatible action present on secp256k1, or an explicitly costed auxiliary-curve construction, must be entered as a separate mechanism.

desk_decisions.rationale: At relation arity four the available small-factor divisor of p-minus-one is far below the approximately two-to-the-sixty-four factor-base scale; this decides only the m-equals-four instantiation.
reopening_conditions: A different arity or construction must receive its own typed applicability and total-cost analysis; the arity-four screen does not close the route.

authorization_boundary: Typed cells and desk decisions authorize nothing. Only an open cell may seed an untrusted proposal, and every later experiment and promotion gate remains separate.
